description: This file contains startup classes for configuring two-factor authentication features in an OrchardCore module, including services registration and route mapping for various authentication methods like authenticator apps, email, and SMS.

classes.name: TwoFactorAuthenticationStartup
classes.description: Configures services and routes for two-factor authentication features.

classes.name: AuthenticatorAppStartup
classes.description: Sets up authenticator app two-factor authentication, including token provider configuration and routes.

classes.name: EmailAuthenticatorStartup
classes.description: Configures email-based two-factor authentication, including token provider setup and endpoints.

classes.name: SmsAuthenticatorStartup
classes.description: Configures SMS-based two-factor authentication, including token provider setup and endpoints.

methods.name: ConfigureServices
methods.description: Registers services needed for each authentication method and feature.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Defines route mappings for authentication actions.
